channel.title: Swiftrix blog
channel.description: Automation and AI agents for business, in plain words.

item.title: How to automate monthly reports instead of copying data into Excel
item.description: Monthly reports can be automated when the data sits in systems you can export from and the layout stays the same. How it works, and when it is not worth it.

item.title: How to tell if a task is too messy to automate
item.description: A practical test for whether a messy office task can be automated, can be automated after tidying, or should stay with a person, with signs to look for in each case.

item.title: How much does business automation cost, and what drives the price
item.description: What a small business automation project costs, the factors that push the price up or down, the running costs to expect, and when it is not worth paying for.

item.title: How to automate order entry from customer emails
item.description: An AI agent can read order emails and PDFs, match products and customers, and draft the order in your system. What it involves, what to check, and when not to.

item.title: Automation or an AI agent: which one does your business need?
item.description: Automation follows fixed rules, an AI agent reads messy input and decides the next step. How to tell which one fits your task, with office examples.

item.title: How to automate invoice handling without replacing your accounting software
item.description: You can automate invoice reading, matching and filing on top of the accounting software you already use. Here is how it works and what to check first.

item.title: What an AI agent can actually do for a small business
item.description: A practical look at what AI agents do well in a small business today, what they still get wrong, and how to start without risking your customers or your data.

item.title: Which office tasks are worth automating, and which are not
item.description: A simple test for deciding which repetitive office tasks to automate first, with examples of tasks that pay off quickly and tasks that are better left alone.
